context.scope_note: Tenant data paths touched: entity_field_grants (per-tenant field access), agent auth context (role extraction from OIDC tokens), sandbox claim/list (per-tenant sandbox isolation)

task.description:
Hard gate security review for changes on branch feature/WF02-qry05-sbx01-03-20260818 (commit e197a78a).

Review all changed files against the numbered security invariants in docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md.

Key areas to check:
1. QRY-05 field stripping: verify stripped fields are ABSENT (not null), verify no cross-tenant grant leakage, verify tenant schema scoping of field_grants queries
2. SBX-01 role gate: verify both credentials required, verify conflicting-roles check fires BEFORE handler, verify audit events on all rejection paths
3. SBX-02 principal: verify client-supplied orchestrator_principal is DISCARDED before canonicalisation, verify no code path hashes a client-supplied principal
4. SBX-03 sandbox: verify orchestrator cannot claim/execute sandboxes, verify implementer list is owner-scoped, verify no sandbox owner enumeration
5. Auth extension: verify AgentRealmRole extraction does not allow privilege escalation via token crafting

Return PASS if all invariants satisfied. Return FAIL with specific findings if not.

result.summary: All eight security invariants reviewed against the branch diff (commit e197a78a). No BLOCKER findings. One MINOR audit-coverage gap recorded. INV-1 through INV-8 assessed individually below.

invariant_assessments.INV-1: PASS. Both migrations carry '-- scope: tenant_only'. loadFieldGrants and all sandbox/task-spec queries run on a pool connection already bound to the tenant schema via search_path. No business table created in public.
invariant_assessments.INV-2: PASS. stripDeniedFields removes denied keys from the JSON object entirely (key is skipped in the iterator, never assigned null). narrowAllowlist removes denied fields from the filter/sort surface before compile(). The SPA never receives an unauthorised field.
invariant_assessments.INV-3: N/A. No Lua or Wasm host-API functions were added or changed.
invariant_assessments.INV-4: PASS. No secret material or credential strings appear in any new struct, audit payload, or response body. orchestrator_principal in audit records is auth.user_id (OIDC subject), not a secret.
invariant_assessments.INV-5: PASS. handleClaimSandbox issues a blind UPDATE (no prior SELECT); both 'sandbox not found' and 'sandbox already claimed by another implementer' paths return HTTP 201 with identical body {}. Cross-tenant sandboxes are invisible via schema isolation. Orchestrator full-list access is by explicit design (supervisory read).
invariant_assessments.INV-6: PASS. All three new data-access paths (field_grants query, sandbox list/claim, task-spec insert) are assessed in this handoff.
invariant_assessments.INV-7: PASS. All SQL in field_grants.zig, agent_sandboxes.zig, and agent_task_specs.zig uses $N parameterised placeholders. No std.fmt.allocPrint interpolation into SQL text found.
invariant_assessments.INV-8: PASS. No 'catch unreachable' on external I/O or tenant-controlled data paths. The single 'orelse unreachable' in canonical_json.zig (obj.get(key) after iterating obj.keys()) is provably safe.

issues.description: The conflicting_agent_roles path (SBX-01 AC5) returns HTTP 403 directly from authenticate() without writing an audit event. The task_spec.submission_rejected audit is written in the route handler, which is never reached for conflicting-roles tokens. This is an observability gap for a potentially adversarial token presentation. No data is exposed and the gate fires correctly; the gap is audit coverage only.
issues.recommendation: Write a tenant-scoped audit event (e.g. 'agent_auth.conflicting_roles_rejected') in the auth middleware before returning .forbidden, consistent with the rejection-path audit discipline applied in agent_task_specs.zig and agent_sandboxes.zig.
